text:
1858, Allahabad: 8 villages became one Civil Lines. Why so many Indian cities still have one:
1. Old city: dense lanes
2. Cantonment: soldiers, run separately
3. Civil Lines: the officers who ran the district, kept apart from both
4. The unit: one bungalow on a big walled plot, wide tree-lined roads
5. Delhi's officials lived in Civil Lines until New Delhi; the Viceroy left in 1930
Is your city's Civil Lines still its greenest part, or has it filled up? #civillines
